sources.title: Perplexity Macro VM - GitHub
sources.snippet: Deterministic 16-bit research VM that runs Perplexity-style planning → search → evidence → critique → synthesis compiled to ROM. Elixir GenServer OTP + Phoenix LiveView streams every retired instruction. Host does web/model/code work behind typed capability boundaries; VM owns control flow.
